query: Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A), and Item 8 Financial Statements and Supplementary Data sections specifically covering "Income Taxes" and "Commitments and Contingencies".

extraction.tax_onetime_note: One-time income tax charge of $10.2 billion, net, related to the European Commission State Aid Decision (ECJ confirmed the 2016 decision in September 2024), representing $15.8 billion payable to Ireland via release of escrow, partially offset by a U.S. foreign tax credit of $4.8 billion and decrease in unrecognized tax benefits of $823 million
extraction.tax_contingency_note: Total gross unrecognized tax benefits of $22.0 billion as of September 28, 2024, of which $10.8 billion would impact the effective tax rate if recognized; reasonably possible decrease of $5 billion to $13 billion in the next 12 months primarily related to intercompany transfer pricing and deemed repatriation tax
